title: Protocol 24 upgrade ledger: fee pool grows by 31879035 stroops more than the fees charged
why: The Protocol 24 upgrade adds 31879035 stroops to the header's feePool with no transaction or ledger-entry change behind it, and resets the live Soroban state size window. Readers that reconcile feePool from transaction fees, or total coins from meta, find a gap only the header explains.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger with 227 transactions, captured for this entry; header protocol 24, transactions applied under Protocol 23.

values.note: 36441867 above the previous ledger's 82293666154318; the transactions account for 4562832.

notes: Arithmetic from the bytes: the previous ledger 59501298 (lake key FC74C5FF--59456000-59519999/FC74150D--59501298.xdr.zst, read from the public lake and not vendored) has fee_pool 82293666154318; this ledger has 82293702596185, a delta of 36441867. The 227 transactions' fee_charged sum to 4562832 (8959549 debited in fee processing, 4396717 refunded after all transactions), so 31879035 of the delta comes from the upgrade. The one upgrade change pair resets live_soroban_state_size_window: all 30 slots become 1216998831. Written by stellar-core 24.1.0 within a day of closing (not regenerated).
